question: A balanced diet takes care of all the following aspects, EXCEPT one. Identify the aspect.

options.text: Meets the RDA for all nutrients
Includes a variety of food items

solution:
The correct answer is** __Promotes a healthy mind__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Balance Diet**

 
 
• A **balanced diet consists of a range of meals in the right amounts and ratios** to provide the body with all the necessary elements it needs each day.
 
• These elements include **proteins, carbs, fats, vitamins, minerals, water, and fibre**.
 
• Such a diet **aids in promoting and maintaining good health and also offers a reserve of nutrients to resist brief periods of deprivation **when those nutrients are not provided by the diet.
 
• The following **aspects** are taken care of by a balanced diet:
 
 
• Meets the **RDA for all nutrients**
 
• Includes nutrients in **correct proportions**
 
• Includes a** variety of food items**
 
• Preserve and promotes **good health**
 
• Provides a **safety margin for nutrients**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **safety margin covers the days we fast as well as any temporary nutrient deficiencies** in our everyday diet.
 
• The s**afety margin is already built in if a balanced diet satisfies an individual's Recommended Dietary Allowances (RDAs)**, as RDAs are created with additional allowances in mind.
 
• Taking care that **each group of foods is present in the meals is one of the simplest strategies to create a balanced diet**.
 
• The **Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) **recommends **five fundamental food groups**.
 
• These consist of:
 
 
• **Products, grains, and cereals**
 
• **Pulses and legumes**
 
• **Dairy and meat products**
 
• **Fruits and vegetables**
 
• **Fats and sugars**
